ana_csm: Heads-up — FjordTech renewal in ~6w. Prod calls fell ~79% yesterday. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/fjordtech
usage-bot: ALERT: fjordtech-prod requests down 79% (24h). No 5xx spike; token spend down. Affected: /embed, /search.
tom_sales: On the last call they said they're trialing WaveAI this sprint. Noted in SFDC.
rachel_se: Support ticket shows client changed their routing to a local vector store on 2026-04-12. Attached config snippet.
ana_csm: That smells like partial migration + competitor pilot. Proposed triage: 1) 30m sync with their ML lead, 2) brief cost/latency note, 3) offer limited Dedicated credit tied to a joint tech session.
tom_sales: Sales wants a 4-week credit + joint tech session. I'll draft the offering.
rachel_se: Eng can run a 30m migration backstop demo Wed 9am PT and prepare a short runbook to revert routing.
devops-bot: Billing hold requires customer request + finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request.
sophia_finance: We need written request and migration evidence to approve holds; can expedite with docs.
ana_csm: Actions: Tom — draft credit; Rachel — tech deck & runbook; Ana — cost brief and renew-risk note. Setting renewal_risk = "elevated" until sync.
tom_sales: I'll send invites and include procurement.
rachel_se: Uploaded runbook draft to /shared/cs/fjordtech.
ana_csm: Thanks team — keep updates here. If usage drops further before the meeting, escalate to "high" and loop finance. :+1:
